name: 30-day content kit
description: The one prompt from the reel: Claude goes through your Instagram and three accounts in your niche, finds what is working, and plans your next 30 days.

page.title: Plan your next month of Instagram
page.sub: The one prompt from the reel. Claude reads your profile, studies three accounts in your niche, finds the reels that beat their own average, and plans 30 days of posts with every hook scored.
page.prompt_how:
1. Install the Claude in Chrome extension: claude.com/claude-in-chrome
2. Open Instagram in Chrome and sign in.
3. Paste this into Claude, with your handle and three accounts in your niche in the square brackets.
page.prompt_note: No extension? Paste the view counts of your last 12 reels, and of three accounts in your niche, under the prompt instead.

prompt:
Go to instagram.com/[your handle]/reels and read the view count on my 12 newest reels. Do the same for these three accounts in my niche: [account 1], [account 2], [account 3]. Then act as my content strategist:

1. Name my top performer and say in one line why it won.
2. For each niche account, work out its median views, list every reel that beat it by 2x or more with the multiple, and name the hook pattern each one used.
3. Plan 30 days of Instagram content for me, one post a day, as a table: day, format (Reel, carousel or Story), topic and hook (the first line people hear). Build on what worked for me and those hook patterns, rewritten for my audience.
4. Score every hook out of 10 for how likely it is to stop a stranger scrolling. Be tough, and rewrite any hook under 7, with the old score.
5. Write the three highest-scoring Reels in full: a word-for-word script under 30 seconds, what to show on screen, and the caption.

followups.label: Write the rest
followups.prompt: Write the next three Reels from the plan in full, the same way: a word-for-word script under 30 seconds, what to show on screen, and the caption.
followups.note: Repeat it until every Reel in the plan has a script.

followups.label: Go deeper on one account
followups.prompt: Open [account] again and read the captions of its three biggest reels. Tell me what each promises in the first line, and write three hooks for me in that shape.
followups.note: Use it on the account closest to yours.

followups.label: Plan next month
followups.prompt: Here is what happened this month: my best post was [post], my worst was [post]. Plan the next 30 days and do more of what worked.
followups.note: Run it again each month with your real results.

checklist.title: Install Claude in Chrome
checklist.detail: Get it at claude.com/claude-in-chrome. It is Anthropic's own extension, on paid Claude plans, and lets Claude read pages in your browser.

checklist.title: Open Instagram and sign in
checklist.detail: Claude reads what you can see, so use the browser where you are logged in.

checklist.title: Paste the prompt
checklist.detail: Add your handle and three accounts in your niche.

checklist.title: Check the numbers it read
checklist.detail: Glance at your own reels to see the view counts match before you trust the plan.

checklist.title: Film the top three
checklist.detail: The scripts and shot lists are written for you. Start with the highest score.

safety: **Claude reads, it does not post.** Nothing is published or changed on your account.
**Copy the pattern, not the post.** Use the hook shape with your own idea and words.

email.tested: We ran it on our own account and three accounts in our niche: 8 outliers in 36 reels, the biggest 17.5x its account's median, then a 30-day plan with 11 weak hooks rewritten. The prompt and three follow-ups are on your kit page: plan.signalservice.ai/content
email.safety: Claude only reads the pages; nothing is posted for you. Copy the hook pattern, not someone's post.
